g.text: PDF text layer quality validation heuristics:
- Word recognition rate (real words vs character soup)
- Character entropy (OCR garbage has unusual distribution)
- Text/image layer overlap (scan+OCR both at same coords)
- born_digital: text layer quality validated -> fast path
- born_digital_degraded: poor OCR text -> image pipeline
- scanned: no text layer -> image pipeline
Fast path: DOCX, HTML, MD, LaTeX, CSV,
XML, EPUB, VTT, validated born-digital PDF
Scanned PDF: use embedded DPI if >= 150 DPI,
Hybrid PDF: per-page — born_digital pages -> fast path,
Convert all inputs to PNG before any ML analysis.
Eliminates JPEG block artifacts that corrupt:
PNG at 300 DPI letter page ~ 8-25 MB (acceptable)
skip rotation (better slightly skewed than wrong 90 deg)
Uses script class from Step 2 to select target:
Safety rails: 150-600 DPI equivalent, no downscaling
Fast ensemble heuristics on corrected + lossless image.
Stroke density, CC analysis, edge density.
Applied AFTER IQA measurement so that IQA
Guided by Classical IQA + SigLIP 2 outputs.
